name: demo-bun-image
description: Demo and smoke-test for Bun's built-in Bun.Image API (v1.3.14+)

scripts.build: mkdir -p ../../dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir ../../dist --target bun --minify --sourcemap=external && bun -e "const{renameSync}=require('fs');const d='../../dist';renameSync(d+'/index.js',d+'/demo-bun-image.js');renameSync(d+'/index.js.map',d+'/demo-bun-image.js.map')"
